subject: Coffee chat request - Arjun Rath (sophomore transfer)
text:
Hi Priya,

My name is Arjun Rath. I'm a sophomore transfer at Stern (I came from Haverford this fall) studying Business with a planned concentration in AI, Computing and Data Science, plus Entrepreneurship.

I'm reaching out because I've been building small businesses since high school, most recently a portable phone-charging station operation in Boston, and SVS is the club I most want to understand before applications open. I'd like to hear how you got involved and what the Venture Team actually works on week to week.

Would you have 15 to 20 minutes for a coffee chat sometime in the next two weeks? I'm happy to work around your schedule and meet anywhere on campus.

Thanks for your time,
Arjun

subject: ICC Newsletter | Week of September 7: Central Club Application opens 9/14
text:
Hi Sternies,

Happy Labor Day, and welcome to the first ICC Newsletter of the fall.

CENTRAL CLUB APPLICATION
This year there is one application for every Stern club program. No more 57 separate Google Forms. The Central Club Application lives at https://www.nyusternicc.org/fall-2026 and requires NYU SSO login.
- Exploratory programs: applications open Monday 9/14 at 9:00 AM and close Saturday 9/19 at 11:59 PM. Interviews 9/19 to 9/26. Decisions go out Sunday 9/27.
- Team programs: applications open Sunday 9/20 at 9:00 AM and close Saturday 9/26 at 11:59 PM. Interviews 9/26. Decisions go out Sunday 10/4.
Resumes are optional for first-years (type N/A in the resume field). Set any linked Google Docs to "anyone with the link can view."

GENERAL MEETINGS THIS WEEK (all 12:30 to 1:30 PM)
Tue 9/8: Strategic Venture Society, Tisch UC21 | Finance Society, Tisch LC13 | Quantitative Finance Society, KMC 2-60
Wed 9/9: Management Consulting Group, Tisch UC24 | Marketing Society, Tisch LC11 | Undergraduate Stern Women in Business, KMC 3-50
Thu 9/10: Entrepreneurial Exchange Group, Tisch LC25 | Business Analytics Club, Tisch UC13 | Blockchain & Fintech Club, KMC 2-70
Fri 9/11: Investment Analysis Group, Tisch UC21 | Net Impact, Tisch LC13

Want to talk to us? Coffee chat with an ICC board member: https://www.nyusternicc.org/join

See you in Tisch,
The Inter-Club Council

subject: Congratulations: Strategic Venture Society Exploratory Program
text:
Dear Arjun,

On behalf of the Strategic Venture Society board, I am thrilled to offer you a place in the SVS Exploratory Program for Fall 2026.

We had over 140 applicants for 24 spots this cycle. Your interview stood out for how concretely you talked about running a real business, and the board agreed you would add a lot to the cohort.

Next steps:
1. Reply to this email by Thursday, October 1 at 11:59 PM to accept or decline your spot.
2. Our first cohort meeting is Tuesday, October 6 at 6:00 PM in KMC 2-60. Attendance is required.
3. If you receive offers from other clubs, please decide promptly so we can extend waitlist offers.

Welcome to SVS. We are excited to work with you.

Warmly,
Sofia

President | Strategic Venture Society

subject: Finance Society Discovery Program: application decision
text:
Hi Arjun,

Thank you for applying to the Finance Society Discovery Program and for taking the time to interview with us last week.

This cycle we received far more strong applications than we had spots, and after a lot of discussion we are not able to offer you a place in the program this fall. This was a hard call and it is not a judgment of your potential.

We would genuinely like to see you around. Our general meetings on Tuesdays at 12:30 are open to everyone, and we run the Discovery Program again in the spring. Several of our current board members got in on their second try.

If you would like feedback on your interview, reply to this email and I will set up ten minutes to talk.

Best,
Ethan

Ethan Walsh
Director, Discovery Program | Finance Society
